reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared isSkippedDay predicate, which every holiday-aware path already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the MM-DD match is one extra clause in the single holiday predicate.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts, the one place that decides whether a day is skipped.

scope.why: One predicate, a clarifying comment and two tests.

maintainability.why: Minimal and obvious, with the accepted entry formats documented at the definition.
